data.text: --rejected is invisible to an agent that has only the init section: it is not in the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md block init writes, not in prime's 'record why' hint, not in search's footer — only at line 135 of .kadence/README.md. KAD-75: 0 of 9 unprompted decisions used it, 7 of 9 wrote the rejected option into --why prose, where rejected-before (DEC-56) cannot read it.
